items.excerpt: Autodesk's Flow Studio adds a 3D Editor + node-based Canvas so creators can block scenes, direct cameras, characters and timing in a real 3D workspace before AI generates the final look. It reframes AI video from prompt-roulette to directable craft.

Volinga Plugin Pro brings relightable 4D Gaussian Splatting captures into Unreal Engine 5, letting VFX and virtual-production teams light neural-captured volumetric footage like normal 3D scenes. A concrete step in making neural rendering art-directable.

CEO Greg Mark explains Backflip's delayed relaunch and how its mesh-to-CAD AI model has improved, turning scans into editable parametric CAD. An interview-level reality check on whether generative reverse engineering is finally usable in product design.

Backflip AI's reworked foundation model converts a mesh into a fully editable feature-tree CAD part in seconds, with a Fusion-facing copilot. For industrial designers it collapses the slowest step between physical scan and editable geometry.

A designer's set of context files created at the start of every client project to onboard Claude — encoding the intent behind tokens that raw hex values and spacing scales can never convey. Practical design-system plumbing for AI collaborators.

Star Trek's voice-first computer, plain-language querying and universal translator anticipated the assistants designers ship today. The piece uses that fiction as a critique of where current AI interface patterns fall short.

UX Collective's weekly digest, this issue centred on information architecture for AI products, the UX of contrast, and designer burnout from constant AI churn. A fast read on where design discourse is landing this week.

An end-to-end map of where AI actually fits in a UX/UI pipeline — research, ideation, UI generation, handoff to real code — argued around the designer shifting from mechanical builder to product director.

GoodBarber details the token and component architecture behind formalising a real design system inside a no-code app builder — the substrate any generative or agentic UI needs if output is going to stay coherent.

Hand-tuned elevation shadows stop reading as one system the moment you have five of them. A tokens-level argument for deriving shadow scales from rules rather than taste — exactly the kind of spec an AI co-designer can follow.

Figma's team on shipping nested folders by treating code as a proposal and turning designer-engineer handoff into an ongoing conversation — a look at how a design tool company itself reworks craft when code becomes cheap to produce.

Vercel's eve agents can now drive a real browser via the agent-browser extension — navigating pages, reading content, clicking and filling forms. That gives build-and-verify agents a way to actually look at the UI they just shipped.

A hands-on ranking of 12 PowerPoint alternatives for 2026, weighing AI-first deck generators like Gamma against Canva, Pitch and Quarto — including where the AI output still needs a designer to rescue it.

Thousands of products now brand themselves as 'agentic AI', and their names crowd into the same 18 semantic territories the chatbots were trained on. A brand-strategy warning for anyone naming an AI product right now.

Gurman reports Apple wants fitness at the centre of its future smart glasses and XR headsets, even though first-gen glasses skip fitness tracking. It signals which use case will shape the wearable interface patterns designers get asked for next.

Figma's official walkthrough of keyframes in Figma Motion — setting property values at points in time to build animation directly in the design file, the manual counterpart to the agent-generated motion shown at Config.
A breakdown of NVIDIA-affiliated research showing why imitation learning alone fails for embodied agents — relevant to anyone designing interactions for robots and physical AI products.
